videos.title: Adidas 3D Printed the Sole of This Shoe 👟 #shorts
videos.description:
The Adidas Futurecraft 4D (2017) has a 3D printed lattice midsole made with Carbon's light-based process: light hardens a liquid resin and the part grows out of the liquid. A lattice lets every zone feel different – softer in the heel, firmer in the front – all in one part.

Source: https://techcrunch.com/2017/04/07/adidas-latest-3d-printed-shoe-puts-mass-production-within-sight/

#shorts #3dprint

videos.title: Robots 3D Printed a Steel Bridge #shorts
videos.description:
Welding robots built this bridge layer by layer out of molten steel – about 12 meters long and around 6 tonnes. Sensors measured how it moved as people walked across, and Queen Máxima opened it over a canal in Amsterdam in July 2021.

Sources: https://www.euronews.com/2021/07/16/the-world-s-first-3d-printed-steel-bridge-has-opened-in-amsterdam · https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/6

videos.title: A Hidden Photo Inside 3D Printed Plastic 🤯 #shorts
videos.description:
A lithophane looks like a plain white plate – until you put a light behind it. Thin areas glow bright, thick areas stay dark, so the photo is hidden in the thickness. The idea was patented in France in 1827 (porcelain!), and today free tools turn any photo into a 3D model for white PLA.

Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lithophane

#shorts #3dprinting #lithophane #diy #giftidea

videos.title: Your Car Has Up to 150 Computers 🚗 #shorts
videos.description:
Modern cars can have up to 150 ECUs – electronic control units, most with a microcontroller inside. One runs the engine, others the brakes, gearbox, doors, seats and the battery in EVs. And they constantly talk to each other over a network inside the car.

Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electronic_control_unit

#shorts #cars #microcontroller #automotive #tech

videos.title: This Computer Costs 3 Cents #shorts
videos.description:
The Padauk PMS150C is a complete microcontroller for about 3 cents each (at 100 pieces). It has just 64 bytes of RAM and can be programmed only once – perfect for cheap gadgets made by the million, like blinking toys and simple lights.

Source: https://jaycarlson.net/2019/09/06/whats-up-with-these-3-cent-microcontrollers/

#shorts #microcontroller #electronics #padauk #embedded

videos.title: The Moon Computer Was Weaker Than a $5 Chip 🌕 #shorts
videos.description:
The Apollo Guidance Computer weighed 32 kg, ran at about 1 MHz and had around 4 KB of working memory – its programs were literally woven into wire (core rope memory). A $5 ESP32 has two cores at 240 MHz, 520 KB of RAM, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. What will you build with yours?

Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apollo_Guidance_Computer

#shorts #esp32 #apollo #nasa #microcontroller

videos.title: He Threw Away 8,000 Bitcoin 😱 #shorts
videos.description:
In 2013, James Howells threw out an old hard drive holding the keys to 8,000 bitcoin. For over ten years he asked the city of Newport, Wales, to let him dig through the landfill. In 2025 the courts rejected his case. At today's prices, that drive would be worth over $650 million.

Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitcoin_buried_in_Newport_landfill

#shorts #bitcoin #crypto #lostbitcoin #story

videos.title: Who Is Satoshi Nakamoto? The $90 Billion Mystery #shorts
videos.description:
On October 31, 2008, someone called Satoshi Nakamoto published the Bitcoin white paper. The first block contained a newspaper headline about bank bailouts. In 2011 Satoshi wrote he had "moved on to other things" and disappeared. An estimated 1.1 million bitcoin linked to Satoshi have never moved.

Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Satoshi_Nakamoto

#shorts #bitcoin #satoshi #crypto #mystery

videos.title: The $800 Million Pizza 🍕 #shorts
videos.description:
On May 22, 2010, programmer Laszlo Hanyecz paid 10,000 bitcoin for two pizzas – worth about $41 back then. At around $82,000 per bitcoin (October 2026), those coins would be worth over $800 million. That's why May 22 is Bitcoin Pizza Day.

Source: https://www.coindesk.com/learn/what-is-bitcoin-pizza-day/
⚠️ Not financial advice.

videos.title: Why There Will Never Be More Than 21 Million Bitcoin #shorts
videos.description:
Every ~10 minutes a new block is added to the chain. Miners race to guess a special number, and the winner gets new bitcoin – currently 3.125 BTC per block. About every four years that reward is cut in half, so the last bitcoin is expected around the year 2140.

⚠️ Not financial advice.

videos.description:

videos.title: This Steak Was 3D Printed 🥩 #shorts
videos.description:
Redefine Meat 3D prints plant-based steaks layer by layer, with a "muscle" and a "fat" part to copy the texture of real meat – made from soy and pea protein, chickpeas, beets and coconut fat. It has been served in restaurants in cities like London, Berlin and Amsterdam. Would you try it?

Source: https://www.techbrew.com/stories/2021/11/17/3d-printed-steaks-are-now-being-served-at-restaurants-acro
